source.item_copy_description: Undated 139-work-volume 101-physical-book woodblock/composite holding; interpretive historical note belongs to curatorial essay not native ancient leaf

curatorial_interpretations.original_korean: 본 《고려사》의 印出은 1452년(端宗 元) 12월로 보아지나 그것이 活印인지, 木板印인지는 분명하지 않다.
curatorial_interpretations.meaning: Curatorial estimate of printing in December 1452; admits movable-type versus woodblock uncertainty

curatorial_interpretations.original_korean: 그것이 널리 반포된 것은 癸酉靖難 이후 1453년 10월의 일인 것 같으나, 현재까지 전해지는 것은 없다.
curatorial_interpretations.meaning: Curatorial proposal of wide dissemination after October 1453, explicitly tentative and with no surviving copies of that early print

historical_annals_crosscontrols.primary_received_text: 春秋館啓請印《高麗史》, 從之。
historical_annals_crosscontrols.observed: Printing request approved; neither completion nor distribution date supplied

historical_annals_crosscontrols.primary_received_text: 故但印《節要》頒賜, 而《全史》則少印, 只藏內府。 ... 請印《全史》廣布。 從之。
historical_annals_crosscontrols.observed: Contemporaneous report full history had limited palace-only copies previously, followed by new approval for broader printing; not proof that new widespread printing finished
